facts.text: MoDeSuite is built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim and the Isaac Lab framework
The prerequisites are Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.10, NVIDIA Isaac Sim 4.2.0 and Isaac Lab
MoDe-Spot-Bend-v0 is registered with entry point task.Bend.spot_bend_env:SpotBendRodEnv
The action space has 9 components: 3 for the base and 6 for the arm
The observation space has 58 components and the rod is sampled at node_num=4 points
The simulation dt is 1/200 s and the decimation is 2
The episode length is episode_length_s = 1000.0/40.0, i.e. 25 s
The first three action components drive the base and the last six the arm; the arm target is command + dt * command * action_scale
The observation concatenates sampled rod nodal positions, root position, root quaternion, target, joint positions and joint velocities
The reward is the negative sum of four target distances, +1 when the arm end or the rod end beats its reference, +10 when the flag is set and -500 when the base is unbalanced
reach_flag is true when the rod end is closer than 0.3 to the target
The base is unbalanced when the gravity direction deviates by more than 45 degrees
An episode ends on timeout or when reach_flag or the balance check fires

determinism.notes: the package's fake resets from Python's random.Random(seed) and its transitions are deterministic, so one seed repeats a trajectory; the upstream Isaac Lab environment seeds PhysX and its samplers separately, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two

gaps: the fake is an analytic/kinematic stand-in (F0): it has no rigid-body, contact or soft-body dynamics and no PhysX scene, so forces, contacts, friction, deformable-rod behaviour and the 10 ms physics decimation of the upstream environment are not modelled
the upstream environment needs NVIDIA Isaac Sim 4.2.0, Isaac Lab, a GPU and USD assets (README.md:19 and :50-53); the sim backend was not run and the fake was never compared with it
the fake returns the configured 58-element observation as Python floats and a simplified distance reward; upstream returns torch tensors and the four-term reward of compute_rewards
no actuator, sensor, camera or noise model is implemented and there is no rendering
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state, so determinism is seeded rather than exact

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
